scope: Nonstationary boundary identities and fresh fixed-state CTMC controls.

fresh_controls.name: warm_driven_ring

band.target: actual total nonstationary hidden path entropy in nats
band.preparation_contract: external guarantee rho_0<=C*pi; same stationary-reference dynamics and all-even reversal

stationary_reference_band.target: realised full hidden path entropy in nats
stationary_reference_band.inference_contract: fixed witnesses, weights and deterministic checkpoint schedule
stationary_reference_band.continuation_contract: same stationary all-even Markov dynamics continues
stationary_reference_band.mechanism: conditional entropy likelihood-ratio supermartingale; no observed-statistic martingale asserted

fresh_controls.coverage_scope: every grid point and all microscopic-jump minima; actual entropy is >=reference at all intervening times for delta preparation
